metadata.description: Generic, reusable Claude Code skills and hooks for software development. Install each plugin separately.

plugins.name: handoff
plugins.description: Skill: hand work off to the next Claude Code session with a minimal, non-redundant handoff file.

plugins.name: compact
plugins.description: Skill and hooks: decide whether this session can be /compacted safely, re-orient Claude after compaction, and log compaction summaries.

plugins.name: release
plugins.description: Skill: cut a release with the version bumped consistently in every manifest, a changelog entry, verification, commit and tag.

plugins.name: publish-check
plugins.description: Skill: scan what is about to be published for secrets, personal identifiers, machine paths and internal URLs.

plugins.name: context-audit
plugins.description: Skill: prune CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md and auto memory of stale, duplicated and derivable entries.

plugins.name: retro
plugins.description: Skill: turn a session's mistakes and corrections into durable rules, memories, skill fixes or automation.

plugins.name: plan-status
plugins.description: Skill: read-only report of where the work stands, checking the plan against git.
